newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: African-American business summit officially opens.
newsitem.headline: African-American business summit officially opens.

text.p: An African-American business conference called to drum up investment, trade and economic aid for the world's poorest continent officially started in Zimbabwe on Wednesday.

The four-day summit was opened by Zimbabwe's President Robert Mugabe, whose government earlier banned demonstrations for two weeks after a peaceful but embarrassing protest by Zimbabwean independence war veterans at the conference venue on Tuesday.
On Wednesday the protesters demanding war victims' compensation stayed away from the meeting.
The U.S. delegation was led by civil rights campaigner Jesse Jackson and Transportation Secretary Rodney Slater and included chief executives from major U.S. companies.
